title: Your agents' first day through one door; three asks: the schedules, the CRM key, three questions
when: 5 November 2026, 17:30 UTC (scheduled wake, the evening one; since brief 9, 12:25 UTC)
headline: From today your agents take work from your conductor and report back to it, and dev and automation already have. Three asks tonight: approve or change the faster schedules, say yes or no to the team CRM key and an inbox lane, and answer three questions about the door. The 'today' list below is the start of your interview.

for_you.detail: Your conductor every hour 07:20 to 21:20 with the drain folded in; dev and helper every two hours; the designer at 10:40 and 16:40. About 99M tokens a day now, about 158M to 194M proposed (4.8M now, 7.3M to 10.3M proposed, without cache reads). Two choices of mine: briefs twice a day, and the evening brief at 20:20. On a yes, each changed scheduled task also gets the kit's current prompt (your watcher's A-06: the stored prompts of your conductor, dev, dashboard and vault are older than the kit).
options: a cheaper variant (your conductor every two hours, about 28M a day less; or dev every three hours)
for_you.recommend: Yes as proposed, for one day: the accountant measures the real cost at its 07:20 run on Saturday, and you keep it or cut it.

for_you.ask: 🗝️ Decide: the team CRM key, and an inbox lane for your conductor (Dinis's notes, 14:41 and 15:03)
for_you.detail: Checked: the private CRM's key is sealed to my current key, signed by Dinis's conductor's published key (a tampered copy fails the check), it opens, and it is the key of the private CRM vault (5n0aocvz). Your own copy is on your For-you panel, sealed to your site key. Its second layer is paused at Dinis's word, so the vault key reads every record. The inbox lane: your conductor has none yet; it is made with your SG/Send access token, or by Dinis's conductor, which keeps no copy of the key.
for_you.recommend: Yes to both: I keep the key and record what we learn about companies in the CRM, not in files of our own; and Dinis's conductor makes the lane, so your token stays with you.

for_you.ask: ❓ Three questions about the one door
for_you.detail: (a) Should work Dinis gives your agents directly also come through your conductor, as a task file? (b) May the reviewer's ROLE.md and dev's README say 'tell the conductor' on a hold, as the kit now does? (c) Should your command centre's own 'Needs me now' list (people/jose/app/kanban-core.js) show your Actions list instead?
for_you.recommend: Yes to all three: one door in, one list out.

sections.title: Today, for your interview
items: What your agents did (44 commits): your conductor 21 (briefs 8 and 9, your answers recorded, the sales coach, the transcripts item, the one door, and overnight your QR codes and run sheets); the watcher 5 (the whole team, now reporting to me); dev 4 (two n8n guides, WS-41's counts, the one door taken up); the designer 4 (your command centre overnight, your navy wish); the dashboard 4 (your page as one action list); the sales coach 2 (its key); automation 2 (WS-74's note without any key); vault 1 and the helper 1 (their schedules at 01:36 and 01:17, nothing since).

What you decided, in your words: 'Record them' (your eight answers, about 10:30); 'i want dark blue, please go', then 'otherwise keep orange'; 'i also want to create a sales coach agent'; 'yes, go' and 'no n8n' on transcripts; 'You are my only door'.

What you seemed to learn, to check in your interview: that Claude's Managed Agents is the engine and RiskMandate the licence and the logbook; that the simplest transcript path leaves the file where Google puts it; and that being the middleman costs you more than faster schedules would cost in tokens.
